d: After an interview with Louise Redknapp, the girls receive a photoshoot challenge set by Kylie Minogue. and there is another shock at elimination.
The girls are sent packing on a surprise trip, and take part in a freezing photoshoot. Tensions reach boiling point between two of the girls.
The girls fight to become the face of an advertising campaign, and an underwater photoshoot yields unexpected results.
After their first go-see challenge the models take part in a photoshoot with help from cycle 2 runner-up Abbey Clancy.
The girls pose for a photoshoot with the Script and one girl is warned about her attitude.
The girls arrive in Buenos Aires and have their first photoshoot abroad. Tensions mount as a plane ticket awaits one of the girls.
The final four face go-sees and the final 3 is revealed.
The three remaining girls arrive in Buenos Aires for the Fashion Week. They have to work backstage.
The pressure mounts as the remaining two competitors face the glare of the press and the glamour of the modeling high-life before their final showdown.

In the 90 minute season premiere 25 girls arrive at bootcamp and meet their host Elle Macpherson. They also come face to face with the other judges, fashion designer Julian MacDonald, stylist Grace Woodward and ex-male model Charley Speed.

In the first week of the main competition, the final 14 move into their new model house and participate in a lingerie themed photo shoot. The girls then have their first official elimination of the main competition. One girl is sent home.
The girls receive their makeovers, but not all are happy with their new looks. The models are assigned a photoshoot wearing Links of London couture.
The girls meet Girls Aloud singer Nicola Roberts and take part in a photoshoot for Beat Bullying.

The girls take part in a posing challenge on Carnaby Street then film a commercial for Beyonce's new fragrance 'Heat'. The photoshoot involves being covered in chocolate which proves difficult for one girl who shows up hungover.

Alesha Dixon meets the models and tasks them with selling her new jewelry line on live television. After meeting Grace in Gatwick airport they are given £500 to go on a shopping spree. They are then whisked off to Spain to do a photoshoot in swim wear.
The girls take part in an acting challenge on the Hollyoaks set and one girl gets carried away on a night out with some of the cast members. The girls must do a horror style photoshoot.
The models face an icy photoshoot when they fly off to Norway.
This week the girls do a beauty shoot for Revlon and some girls are pushed over the edge in a second shoot for 'Galaxy Ripple'.
